scope: Only the Waseda-specific challenge-session composition constants and predicates. Queue traversal, retry scheduling, selection orchestration, persistence, cloud sync and Rikkyo runtime are out of scope.

exactBehavior.challengePoolShortage: when challenge.length < requiredChallengeCount, return only weighted challenge items up to desired; do not backfill foundation items
exactBehavior.foundationYearEligibility: if a specific year is selected, entity.years must include it
foundationFilterEvaluationOrder: weak OR due OR recent-mistake state eligibility
exactBehavior.foundationReasonAttachment: baseReasons only for selected foundation exceptions using v75FoundationReason
exactBehavior.returnedChallengeCount: count final combined items whose layer resolves to challenge

adapterDesign.reason: Keeping getProgress in runtime after layer/year guards prevents the refactor from creating new default progress entries for entities that legacy Waseda would have excluded before touching learner state.

mustPreserve: all existing learner-visible challenge/foundation ratios and shortage behavior
all current scoring functions and their call order
due-retry precedence and unlimited queue behavior
Waseda schema/storage identifiers and legacy migrations
current public Waseda main and deployment
forbiddenAtThisStage: moving challenge composition policy into the common engine
calling getProgress before layer and year rejection
changing Waseda persistence or cloud sync
changing or deploying Waseda production main
